title: Quick Pasta with Salmon and Tomatoes in Cream Sauce
description: This quick pasta dish with fresh salmon, tomatoes, and cream sauce is ready in under 30 minutes, so perfect for a quick midweek dinner.
ingredients: 10 ounces salmon fillet, cut into cubes
1 pinch salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain.

Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat while spaghetti is cooking and cook salmon and garlic until salmon is lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add tomatoes and basil, season with salt and pepper, and cook for 3 minutes. Pour in cream and simmer over low heat until flavors are well combined and salmon is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Serve sauce over cooked pasta.
